series: Climate Fiscal Policy Brief No. 6.3 · October 2026
title: Price the Capital, Then Test the Budget

slides.title: Price the Capital, Then Test the Budget
slides.subtitle: Climate investment needs, the cost of capital and public spending in CPAT
slides.message: The cost of capital, not the size of the bill, decides whether clean capital pays its way. And a project worth building can still break the budget's cash flow.
slides.author: Stephen J. Stretton · writing in a personal capacity
slides.notes: Two extensions to the World Bank-IMF Climate Policy Assessment Tool: investment needs priced at three rates, and a public-money test with financing routes on one ledger.
